policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV renders the clause as 'They shall all be ashamed,' directly supporting the qere reading associated with shame rather than the ketiv alternative.
ASV explicitly has the plural 'with them,' distinguishing qere בם from singular feminine ketiv בה; the alternative-rendering note concerns English wording and does not decide the reading.
ASV's neuter English pronoun 'it' does not distinguish the Hebrew feminine qere היא from masculine ketiv הוא, and no mapped textual-variant note decides between them; retain the qere base fallback.
